component.name: Blockstream
component.summary: A simple and secure Bitcoin and Liquid Network wallet

description.p: Built by one of the most respected teams in the Bitcoin industry, Blockstream App is supported across multiple platforms and is designed for Bitcoin beginners and power users alike.
